name: MEMORY.md
summary: Memory lives in Markdown files that the agent edits with its ordinary file tools: a MEMORY.md index loaded at session start, plus topic or daily files read or searched on demand. OpenClaw keeps a curated MEMORY.md and dated daily notes indexed for search; Claude Code's auto memory keeps a MEMORY.md index that points to one topic file per memory.
how: The agent writes the files itself with its ordinary file tools
Keep MEMORY.md short: durable facts, decisions and pointers
Put detail in topic files or dated notes such as memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md
Load MEMORY.md into the prompt at the start of every session
Open or search the other files only when needed; prune MEMORY.md near its load limit
facts: Through the agent's ordinary file tools, not a dedicated memory tool
Claude Code loads the first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md
Readable and editable, but recall degrades as files grow
goodFor: Memory a human can read and edit
watchOut: Injected copy is truncated once the file outgrows its budget
Quality depends on the model curating the file well
